items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Dashboard Control Grade now reads sbom_render.unresolved_count, the SBOM's own count; test pins equality on a fixture with unknown + not-installed licenses.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Pure counting over an existing list; empty deps returns 0.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: No I/O, no input parsing, no secrets.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Test fails on the old dashboard count (3 vs 8) and asserts against the rendered SBOM text, not a re-implementation.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: One extra linear pass over dependencies.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: Removed the dashboard's private _UNKNOWN_LICENSES set; one helper next to _classify.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: No serialized format changed; both surfaces consume the in-memory DependencyInfo list.
